correctness.rationale: Reconstructed fixed-composition exact run-count pmf by alternating positive-block compositions: even 2k count 2*C(a−1,k−1)C(b−1,k−1), odd 2k+1 count C(a−1,k)C(b−1,k−1)+C(a−1,k−1)C(b−1,k). Decomposing selected adjacent-change indicators into edge components and alternating orientations gives factorial moments through order four, converted via Stirling numbers to a rational fourth cumulant and Q_n(t) (explicit in frozen RESULT). Independently enumerated all fixed-count binary words through n12 and compared exact rational cumulants and formula. Verified transformed (1+y)^3 Q_n((n−1+n²y/4)/(1+y)) coefficients, whose signs are +,+,−,− for n≥10. Descartes plus positive n−1 and negative balanced boundary gives exactly one crossing in feasible range, not just a numerical observation. Exactly checked small n4..9, and asymptotic Q_n(αn²)/n^7→8α(30α²−12α+1). Independent all-integer signs through n400 corroborated. Discrete equality not guaranteed to occur for a feasible ab.
